name: Corning Incorporated
blurb: Corning Incorporated is an American specialty glass and ceramics manufacturer with roots stretching back to 1851. Its Optical Communications segment — the world's largest maker of optical fibre and fibre-optic cable — has become the principal earnings engine as AI-driven data-centre construction accelerates demand for high-capacity fibre infrastructure. Corning also supplies specialty glass for displays, life sciences, and advanced semiconductor substrates, and has a developing presence in co-packaged optics component supply through collaborations with Broadcom and others. The company is headquartered in Corning, New York.
recent: Corning's Optical Communications segment posted full-year 2025 sales of $6.3 billion, up 35% year-over-year, with enterprise data-centre revenue growing 61%. In early 2026, Corning signed a multiyear agreement worth up to $6 billion to supply Meta's global AI data-centre buildout with optical fibre and cable. Bank of America subsequently pegged the total scale-out revenue opportunity at $10.3 billion by 2030. Corning's internal Springboard plan now targets $6.5 billion in incremental annualised sales by end-2026.
